scenarioTitle: Compliance Surfaces Accessibility — WCAG 2.2 AA presenters and honest empty models

criteria.statement: The compliance coverage presenter is structurally/semantically clean and truthful: every gap is surfaced, the boundary is not mislabelled, and internal readiness is never rendered as external certification.
criteria.observedVia: auditComplianceAccessibility({tenant, coverage}) over the shipped renderCoverageView (accessibility oracle)
criteria.negativeControl: were an uncovered obligation row to omit its coverage-gap, or a 'ready' boundary to read as certified, the oracle would return a non-empty findings list (currently 0)

criteria.statement: An un-fed compliance view is honest: its boundary is incomplete (never certified), it states internal readiness is not external certification, and it states no external certification exists.
criteria.negativeControl: were the empty view to report a certified boundary, omit the not-certified note, or render a certification block, this would report a finding
